name: CaseComboboxOptionHighlighted
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "combobox-option-highlighted" (combobox). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: 5 sibling options where ONE is HIGHLIGHTED (active descendant) by a single-SIDE border - `border-left: 3px solid rgb(37, 99, 235)` against a transparent left border on the other four
